name: heat_pump_r22_semihermetic_compressor
title: R22 heat pump with a semi-hermetic compressor model
summary: R22 heat pump whose semi-hermetic (enclosed) reciprocating compressor is described by a clearance-factor volumetric efficiency and a loss model whose electromechanical losses reheat the incoming fresh charge; the evaporator and the condenser are semi-isothermal (epsilon-NTU) exchangers against water flow rates, and the model closes on the saturation pressures of the evaporator and condenser temperatures to give the COP, the heating capacity, the compressor power and the refrigerant flow rate.

authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES solution)
origin.course: ULiège MSTh course (J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio), repetition TP 10, exercise 1

verification.reference: Solution stored in the EES original TM-0154 (MSTH-SB-R10-EX1.EES, EES 7.458, 55 stored variables), compared with tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: compare_solution.py (rtol = 0.001): '55 common variables, 19 differ', largest deviation 6.6e-03 on T_ev (4.388 EES vs 4.359 °C CoolSolve); all 19 deviations follow from the R22 properties of EES 7.458 vs CoolProp (P_ev 573.2 vs 572.5 kPa, h_3 260.4 vs 259.2 kJ/kg) and the water cp at ~12.8 °C (4184.9 vs 4191.0 J/kg-K): COP 3.2955 vs 3.3107 (4.6e-03), Q_dot_ev 56790.8 vs 57053.2 W (4.6e-03). The run needs the shipped .initials (the EES guesses): without them the largest block fails to converge (MaxIterations).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/heat_pump_MSTh_SB_R10.eescode (CSX-020: this model is its curated version; the example stays in the CoolSolve repository)
